ABOUT
About Me


I'm an independent pixel artist and creative director based in Dubai. I know what the NFT market demands today and can adapt my skills to specific business needs, particularly in pixel art and illustration.


I also have a team with a wide skill set across illustration, game development, animation and UI/UX.


I've worked with a variety of clients since 2022, and I'm a versatile artist who can work independently or as part of a team.


I communicate clearly, deliver on time and share regular updates throughout the entire process.

FAQ


How long does a full NFT collection take?
Usually 2 to 5 weeks, depending on trait count and supply. You get a clear timeline before we start.


Do you provide metadata & generation files?
Yes. You get layered trait files, the generated images and metadata JSON formatted for your chain and marketplace.


Can you work under NDA?
Yes. I'm happy to sign one before we discuss details.


What's included in a full package?
Concept and style direction, trait art, generation, metadata, branding assets and launch-ready files.


Do you do revisions?
Unlimited revisions during production, until you're happy with the result.


Do you incorporate AI in your pixel art?
Never. Everything is 100% handcrafted, pixel by pixel, and original to your project. AI-generated artwork can raise copyright and ownership questions, so I don't use generative AI to create my pixel art. ZONIX pixel art is handmade.


Do you handle NFT marketing visuals?
Absolutely. We can build the full visual package around your collection, including logos, X and marketplace banners, social posts, website graphics, roadmaps, animated GIFs, comics and promotional animations.


How do we start?
Send a message below with what you need. I'll reply with a few questions and a quote.

These terms cover use of this website and commissions with Zonix Studio (Mohsin Ahmed Khan). By using the site or requesting work you agree to them. A written quote or agreement for a specific project takes priority over anything here.
Website usage
You may browse this site and use the Pixel Canvas for personal, lawful purposes. Please do not misuse the site, attempt to disrupt it or copy it wholesale.
Intellectual property
The artwork, characters, logo, text and code of this site belong to Zonix Studio unless stated otherwise. Do not copy, resell or use them without written permission. Client reviews belong to their authors.
Artwork and portfolio usage
Work shown in the portfolio is shown to demonstrate my skills. Projects under NDA are not shown. I may display finished commissions in my portfolio unless we agree otherwise in writing.
Client projects and commissions
Commissions start with a message through the contact form or by email. I reply with questions and a quote. Work begins once the scope, price and schedule in the quote are agreed. I am happy to sign an NDA before we discuss details.
Payments
Prices, payment schedule and accepted payment methods are set out in each quote. Work continues according to that schedule.
Revisions
Revisions are included during production until you are happy with the result. Changes that go beyond the agreed scope, such as new characters or extra traits, may be quoted separately.
Deliverables and timelines
Deliverables depend on the project and are listed in the quote. A full NFT collection package can include layered trait files, generated images and metadata formatted for your chain and marketplace. A full collection usually takes 2 to 5 weeks depending on trait count and supply, and you get a clear timeline before we start.
Ready-to-sell collections
Collections listed as available are offered subject to availability. Terms of sale, licensing and transfer of rights are confirmed in writing before payment.
Rights in commissioned work
Unless the quote says otherwise, rights in commissioned work are described in the project agreement. Please agree ownership and licensing in writing before the project starts.
Third-party services and links
The site relies on third-party services such as Google Fonts and links to external sites, including X, Instagram and LinkedIn. I am not responsible for their content or availability.

Privacy Policy
Last updated: 5 October 2026
This policy explains what happens to your information when you use this portfolio website, operated by Zonix Studio (Mohsin Ahmed Khan, Dubai). It describes how the site works today: a static portfolio with no accounts, no analytics and no advertising.
Information collected
The site does not ask you to create an account and does not run analytics or advertising trackers. The only information I receive is what you choose to send me.
Contact form and email
The contact form does not send data to a server. When you press Send message, it opens your own email app with a pre-filled message containing your name, email, project type and message. Nothing leaves your device until you send that email yourself. Emails you send to Contact@zonixstudio.com are handled by your email provider and mine.
How information is used
I use the details in your email only to reply to your enquiry, prepare a quote and run a commission if you hire me. I do not sell your information.
Cookies and local storage
This site does not set cookies and does not store data in your browser's local storage. Pictures you make with the Pixel Canvas stay in your browser. They are not uploaded, and the PNG download is created on your device.
Third-party services
  • Google Fonts: the Pixelify Sans, Tiny5 and Silkscreen fonts are loaded from Google. Google receives your IP address and browser details when the fonts load, under Google's own privacy policy.
  • Hosting: whichever provider serves this site may keep standard server logs such as IP address and request times.
External links
The site links to X, Instagram and LinkedIn, and each client review links to that person's public X profile. Those sites have their own privacy practices, and I am not responsible for them. Reviews show the public name, handle and profile picture of the people who wrote them.
Data security
I keep emails in my own email account and take reasonable care to protect them. No method of transmission or storage over the internet is completely secure.
Your rights
You can ask me to tell you what emails I hold from you, correct them or delete them. Depending on where you live, you may have further rights under local data-protection law. Email me at Contact@zonixstudio.com.
Policy updates
If the site changes, for example by adding analytics, I will update this page and the date above.
